# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster knows the proper dimesions need to make a false limb for the target.
@@ 2
Caster may mold target wood (up to 4 cubic feet) as if it were clay when he
concentrates. It normally takes 1 day (approximately 8 hours) to mold an
artificial limb. At the end of the molding time, the target wood returns its
normal hardness.
@@ 3
Caster attaches a wooden (artificial) limb to a body. Process takes 1 hour.
This spell must be cast before an Animation spell can be cast.
@@ 4
Allows wearer to operate an artificial limb at will for 8 hours.
@@ 5
As Mold Wood, except works on glass. The process takes 2 days (approximately 8
hours per day) hours to mold.
@@ 6
As Fit Wood; except allows caster to fit a glass limb.
@@ 7
As Animation I, except duration is 24 hours.
@@ 8
As Mold Wood, except involves basic metals and the process takes 4 days
(approximately 8 hours per day).
@@ 9
As Fit Wood; allows caster to fit a normal metal limb.
@@ 10
This spell enables caster to convert clay into enough artificial flesh to
cover one artificial limb (limb must be present at the time of casting). The
flesh is only semi-realistic (similiar to plastic). The process takes 2 days
(approximately 8 hours each day), but might require more for larger limbs
(GM’s discretion).
@@ 11
As Animation I, except duration is 1 week.
@@ 13
As Fit Wood; except allows caster to fit limbs of enchanted materials (the
limb must be created through some other means).
@@ 15
As Animation I, except duration is 1 month.
@@ 17
As Animation I, except duration is 3 months.
@@ 19
As Animation I, except duration is 6 months.
@@ 20
As Artificial Flesh, except perfectly realistic synthetic flesh can be made
and worked. This process takes 10-100 days, depending on amount of flesh
needed.
@@ 25
As Animation I, except duration is 1 year.
@@ 30
As Animation I, except duration is 1 year per caster’s level.
@@ 50
As Animation, except duration is permanent.
